about: Experience Ghosthunter™ originally released on the PlayStation®2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

A late-night disturbance call leads officer Lazarus Jones of the Detroit P.D. to an abandoned school – the site of a gruesome murder spree some 10 years past. What should have been a routine run descends into a disaster of supernatural proportions when hordes of tortured souls are accidentally unleashed. Burdened with paranormal abilities to perceive and channel these malevolent spirits, it’s now your job to hunt and capture the undead before they achieve their ultimate vengeance on the world of the living.

This title has been converted from the PlayStation®2 version to the PlayStation®4 and PlayStation®5 consoles and provides newly added features. Consequently, there may be times where the title plays differently from the PlayStation®2 version, or where some features may cause the title to not function properly. This version does not support the PlayStation®2 console’s peripherals, therefore some functionality may not be available.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.
summary: Experience Ghosthunter™ originally released on the PlayStation®2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
